description: Bounds of the ReAct repair controller (babeldoc/magazine/react/). Same convention as configs/detectors.json: every numeric parameter carries a '<name>_allowed_range' sibling of the form 'low..high', inclusive on both ends, and the convention holds inside the nested action blocks as well. 'actions' is the vocabulary a decision may choose from; a name outside it, a parameter the chosen action does not declare, or a value outside that parameter's range is a violation and the reply is refused. Each action declares 'issue_kinds', the detector kinds it answers for, 'max_applications', the ceiling on how many paragraphs it may touch over the whole run, its 'parameters' with a default and a range each, and its 'applicability', which is what decides whether a particular finding is one this action may act on at all. Applicability is deliberately stricter than detection: a detector reports what looks wrong and a repair has to be sure, because leaving a defect standing costs one defect and rewriting a correct paragraph costs a correct paragraph. For translate_orphan_lines that is two conditions. 'min_residue_ratio' is the share of the paragraph's script characters that must be in the wrong script -- a paragraph that is almost entirely the wrong script was not translated, whereas a mixed one is a translation that kept a name in its source form, and rewriting the second would undo a correct decision. 'orphan_layout_labels' is the closed set of layout labels an orphan carries: a paragraph the layout parser recovered outside every detected block, which is what 'fallback_line' means and the only way a paragraph reaches typesetting without ever having been offered to the translator. A paragraph carrying any other label was offered and what it renders as is the translator's decision, which this action does not overrule. 'min_source_chars' keeps a folio or a credit glyph from being sent anywhere. Each term carries a sentence in 'statements', keyed by the term it states and carrying '{value}' where the term's own figure goes: the rule is applied from the numbers and stated to the deciding model from these sentences, so a request cannot describe a filter other than the one it is feeding. Every term must carry one and every statement must name a term. 'max_iterations' bounds the detect-decide-act-recheck loop, 'decide_max_attempts' bounds how many times one iteration's decision may be asked for before the iteration is abandoned, and the remaining numbers bound what one request is allowed to carry.

translate_orphan_lines.description: Send the text of an orphan line through the translation engine and write the answer back into the paragraph, then lay that paragraph out again.

statements.min_residue_ratio: its evidence reports residue_ratio at or above {value}
statements.min_source_chars: the text the page renders for it is at least {value} characters long
statements.orphan_layout_labels: its evidence reports layout_label as one of: {value}
